_comment: Where the catalogue importer reads and writes. Folder ids are stable; titles are here only so a human can tell which is which in Drive. Nothing in INPUT is ever moved, renamed or deleted -- the client's originals are the one thing this pipeline must not lose.

input.title: INPUT
input.role: the client's photographs, exactly as they arrived. Read only.

output.title: OUTPUT
output.role: finished transparent PNGs, named for the product.

processed.title: PROCESSED
processed.role: a record of which input files have been dealt with.

errors.title: ERRORS
errors.role: anything that could not be processed, with the reason beside it.

categories._comment: Words that suggest one of the six categories the site actually has. A suggestion only -- every match is shown for confirmation and can be changed. Nothing is invented: a word that matches nothing leaves the category empty and the product goes to review.

limits._comment: Below these, a product is held for review rather than published.
